findings: AO form fields are tagged Word content controls (102–131 per document) → Declared parses deterministically by tag. BUT the v2.0 template reuses tags (DepIENO ×3, ReqTimeDesc holds the 'Silent parameter' row, PredecessorName used for both Catalogue and Intune sections) → parser must key on (section, row label, tag). Fixing the template tags is a one-hour job with big payoff.

Wizard captions carried every decision in 4 of 5 packages; the single screenshot-only fact (Bambu step 7 'keep other options checked') was resolved by comparing walkthrough vs silent result, not by reading the image.

Every question actually sent (Altair Q1, Brother Q1/Q2) and every question that should have been sent (Bambu Q1*/Q2*) is triggered by one of five rules: declared-vs-history contradiction, unresolvable predecessor name, two different quoted paths in one document, mutually exclusive boxes, scope larger than caption.

'Additional Information' is wrong or stale in 3 of 5 (v3 command in a v4 package, 'NA' return codes with 2000 ignored, 'NA' leftovers with observed leftovers). All of it is derivable from script + snapshot.

Complexity Matrix: missing in 3 of 5, reused from predecessor in 1, and the auto-score disagrees with the recorded one where #9/#12 judgement is involved — the disagreement is the useful output, not the number.

Verification evidence is uneven: Admin+SYSTEM only for Brother; Source Validator missing for Zeiss; SysTracer missing for Altair. A sheet with mandatory verification slots makes the gaps visible before handover.

Reuse knowledge (process lists, child-process killers, HKCU keys, class restorations) lives only in predecessor scripts and heads. Recording 'observed_only' facts with their reason is the knowledge base.
